name: Ford - Kansas City Assembly Plant, Claycomo MO

fieldNotes.facility: Kansas City Assembly Plant (F-150 + Transit, two high-volume lines) in Claycomo MO; geocode point lands directly on the plant - identity unambiguous.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View of the SE plant access road shows a clear truck gate: a guard booth, kiosk/card-reader pedestal, stop sign, concrete median separating in/out lanes, and trailers backed into docks beyond. Confirmed controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Street View shows a small multi-window guard booth at the gate with a uniformed guard standing beside it - definitive guard shack.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Concrete median splits the gate into in/out lanes at one entrance point - treated as together (one gate group).
fieldNotes.multiStep: Gate booth plus a separate kiosk/card-reader pedestal indicates a layered check-in stage; campus also has internal checkpoints.
fieldNotes.railServed: Substantial multi-track rail yard runs into the property at the SE with auto-rack rail cars visible.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer drop yards along the NE building face and near the rail yard - many trailers parked separate from active docks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Claycomo is a small edge-of-metro town; the plant is bordered by woods and modest residential development - per rubric, choose Rural over small-town industrial.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple large connected and a separate detached building to the south form an integrated assembly campus.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Overhead estimate; dock doors distributed across multiple building faces.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left uncertain.
